aggregation: Otherwise, any LIMITED criterion gives LIMITED.
Otherwise, all criteria are DOCUMENTED, giving DOCUMENTED.
applicability_rule: Only genuine prospective Questions commissioned strictly AFTER the approved effective boundary may bind this publication. Historical Questions, Answers, original bytes, receipts and later outcomes are never rewritten.
boundaries: No numerical quality score, count threshold, weight, ranking or promotion state.
Assessment result is a separate immutable authority. Structural acceptance remains distinct.
No assessment result changes acceptance, LOWER, UPPER, CONFIDENCE, selection, trading authority or existing history/currentness semantics.
Assessment unavailability preserves a valid accepted forecast.
Later realized outcomes do not rewrite the original forecast or prospective assessment.
No second forecast, confidence override, another AI assessor, option-expression suitability, strike selection, trading, execution or broker authority.

clarifications.contradictory_evidence: An applicable declared UNRESOLVED_CONTRADICTION produces LIMITED under C9. LIMITED means documentary/evidentiary limitation, not FORECAST WRONG, FORECAST REJECTED, DO NOT TRADE, LOW CONFIDENCE, BEARISH or BULLISH.
clarifications.empty_evidence: An empty array or absence of documented evidence does not prove complete investigation or NONE FOUND. Where required documentary evidence or proof of review completion cannot be established, LIMITED is the conservative result. The frozen V3 contract is not changed.
clarifications.honest_disclosure: Do not rewrite Astra’s forecast in response to honest disclosure. C3 must not encourage fabrication of opposing evidence to obtain DOCUMENTED.
clarifications.normal_uncertainty: Normal uncertainty is expected and does not automatically produce LIMITED; a specifically missing obligation or declared unresolved contradiction does.

criteria.astra_asserted: Analyst authorship/model provenance, publisher authenticity, source credibility and independence.
criteria.deterministic_result: DOCUMENTED for intact bindings and links; LIMITED for coverage gaps; NOT_EVALUABLE for assessment-admission failure.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: Restore the accepted child/receipt; match Question, raw/canonical hashes, target, charts, T0 and methodology. Check material source references connect to the horizon’s cited claims.
criteria.title: Identity, provenance and references
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: Missing/corrupt accepted graph or unsupported policy binding prevents assessment. Missing documented material-source connections is an evidence gap.

criteria.astra_asserted: Whether the rationale actually supports the particular bounds, covers the important fundamentals, or is economically persuasive.
criteria.deterministic_result: DOCUMENTED when the required linked coverage exists; otherwise LIMITED.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: Rationale references horizon-applicable material claims. Available commodity and macro research sections provide source-backed claims applicable to h.
criteria.title: Horizon-specific rationale
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: Nonempty prose alone cannot establish those semantic facts. Missing links or unavailable mandatory research remain identifiable gaps.

criteria.astra_asserted: Whether evidence truly supports/opposes the forecast and whether counterevidence was investigated adequately.
criteria.deterministic_result: DOCUMENTED for both recorded perspectives and links; otherwise LIMITED, without requiring fabricated opposition.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: Identify explicit SUPPORT and OPPOSITION relationships referencing forecast h and relevant claims; verify counterevidence links. Bullish/bearish research is retained separately from forecast-relative support/opposition.
criteria.title: Supportive and opposing research
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: Missing opposing evidence cannot be interpreted as proof that none exists. Bullish evidence is not automatically supportive of every submitted range.

criteria.astra_asserted: Whether declarations are complete, realistic and adequately addressed.
criteria.deterministic_result: DOCUMENTED for linked treatment of declarations; LIMITED for missing links or unavailable review-completion evidence.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: Check that assumptions used by material claims and limitations attached to relevant relationships appear in the forecast’s corresponding references, with compatible horizon scope and affected references.
criteria.title: Assumptions and limitations
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: Empty arrays do not establish that a review found no assumptions or limitations.

criteria.astra_asserted: Truth of timestamps, historical page contents and exclusion of undeclared hindsight.
criteria.deterministic_result: DOCUMENTED for recorded chronology; NOT_EVALUABLE for a broken accepted graph. Never convert later retrieval alone into failure.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: Reuse the original versioned acceptance checks: known publication/availability <= T0; availability <= retrieval <= analysis <= original receipt. Check retained availability explanations and locators where supplied.
criteria.title: T0 and source chronology
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: Independent historical-source verification is unavailable to this local assessor. A mismatch with the accepted integrity/validation graph is an admission problem.

criteria.astra_asserted: Correct pixel interpretation, economic transmission and whether the explanation resolves the disagreement.
criteria.deterministic_result: DOCUMENTED for linked reconciliation; otherwise LIMITED.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: Verify available REFERENCE and MCX observations applicable to h, source-backed research, an available reconciliation section, and a typed relationship connecting chart and external-research evidence.
criteria.title: Chart/fundamental reconciliation
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: Missing/unreadable chart evidence or absent reconciliation links cannot be repaired from prose or current market data.

criteria.astra_asserted: Event-calendar completeness, materiality, anticipated impact and treatment of uncertainty.
criteria.deterministic_result: DOCUMENTED for linked declared treatment; LIMITED for missing treatment or unknown review completion.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: For declared events, check source, known-at time, schedule window, horizon applicability and evidence links into the horizon’s rationale, uncertainty or confidence justification. Report whether the schedule is before, across or after expiry.
criteria.title: Scheduled-event treatment
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: An empty list does not prove investigation found no events. An after-expiry event can have asserted anticipatory relevance; its timing alone is not a failure.

criteria.astra_asserted: Whether the percentage is well judged, whether the explanation justifies it, and whether path risks are realistic.
criteria.deterministic_result: DOCUMENTED for linked explanations; otherwise LIMITED. No confidence override.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: Verify that both horizon-specific statements reference applicable evidence. Preserve the accepted confidence and bounds exactly.
criteria.title: Confidence justification and path risk
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: Calibration, no-touch probability and option-selling expectancy are unavailable from these statements.

criteria.astra_asserted: Whether a contradiction exists but was omitted, and whether a declared resolution is convincing.
criteria.deterministic_result: An applicable declared unresolved contradiction yields LIMITED; otherwise DOCUMENTED only for the observable record checks.
criteria.mechanically_verifiable: Locate applicable UNRESOLVED_CONTRADICTION records; check their explanation, limitation references and forecast linkage. Inspect recorded reconciliation relationships.
criteria.title: Declared unresolved contradictions
criteria.unavailable_or_not_evaluable: Absence of a declared contradiction is not proof of semantic consistency. Empty relationship evidence leaves coverage uncertain.

definitions.chart_backed_claim: A linked claim with a corresponding resolvable observation link.
definitions.linked_claim: An exact evidence ID resolving within that commodity’s accepted Answer, with horizon applicability including h.
definitions.source_backed_claim: A linked claim with a corresponding resolvable source link.
definitions.verification_boundary: These checks establish recorded links; they do not establish evidential truth.

execution_boundary: TE-05C owns assessment execution. TE-05B publishes and admits this descriptor only; it does not execute C1–C9.
independence: Every criterion and the aggregate result are evaluated separately for E1 and E2. Shared commodity evidence may support both horizons only where explicitly applicable. No commodity-level roll-up or package-wide grade exists in V1.
permitted_claim: KRONOS verified the integrity and required documentary relationships of this assessment.

states.DOCUMENTED: The proposed observable predicate is satisfied. It certifies the presence, scope and linkage of the required documentation.
states.LIMITED: The accepted record is assessable, but a required witness is missing, a mandatory evidence family is declared unavailable, review completion cannot be established, or an applicable unresolved contradiction is declared. Retain exact reasons and references.
states.NOT_EVALUABLE: A trusted assessment cannot be admitted: approved policy unavailable/inapplicable, unsupported version, or accepted evidence/binding cannot be restored reliably.
